test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the MISSPELT word in the following sentence.

In some regions of the world, child poverty remains a serious issue, significently in relation of the geospatial and living standards in which children grow up.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'significently'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The misspelt word is **'significently'.**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"significantly".**
 
• "Significantly" means in a noticeable or important way. **(महत्वपूर्ण तरीके से)**
 
• It is often used when you want to specify something that
